problems.memo_sentence: "On synthetic clustered and time-series datasets, the selector algorithm reliably picks one representative from each cluster and maintains better-than-random accuracy even at high noise levels."
problems.source_evidence: "While that accuracy decreases at higher σ, even at σ > 3 where the two sets of density curves (figure (c)) are indistinguishable, the selector algorithm can pick out curves from each cluster with better-than-random accuracy."
problems.explanation: The memo omits the caveat that accuracy decreases as noise increases and that the clusters become visually indistinguishable at high σ. The source supports better-than-random performance, but not the stronger impression of reliable cluster recovery across all noise levels.

problems.memo_sentence: "The authors implement an unsupervised representative selection algorithm whose core framework is a QUBO with one binary variable per data point and a quadratic penalty enforcing selection of exactly k items."
problems.source_evidence: "In all following analyses, we use only the binary case, where the weighted subspace is restricted to only binary values, ⃗w → ⃗x ∈ {0, 1}^n ..." and Appendix C: "the main article" uses the binary case, while a more general weighted formulation is presented separately.
problems.explanation: The memo presents the binary formulation as the algorithmic framework without reflecting that the paper explicitly distinguishes this binary case from a more general weighted extension in Appendix C. This limitation/qualification is part of the paper’s methodological framing.

problems.memo_sentence: "In the cryptocurrency diversification experiment, the D-Wave Advantage annealer substantially outperforms the older 2000Q in satisfying the cardinality constraint and achieving low-cost solutions, with both devices still selecting portfolios that are far better than random in terms of the cost function."
problems.source_evidence: "The average cost function value of both devices was significantly lower than the average value considering all possible solutions. The average value of the cost function for the 2000Q device is in the lowest 4% of possible values, while the average value of the cost function for the Advantage QPU is in the lowest 0.03% of all solutions."
problems.explanation: The memo captures the comparison but omits the paper’s explicit quantitative caveat that the 2000Q average is still in the lowest 4% of all solutions, while Advantage is in the lowest 0.03%. The omission weakens the precision of the reported comparison.
